verdict.rationale: Keycloak's Server Administration Guide documents built-in, per-realm SCIM endpoints for managing users and groups, so an external directory can push users and groups via a service account client. Deprovisioning then removes or disables the Keycloak user, but that this revokes app access is implied, not documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation that a SCIM delete or deactivate revokes active sessions and tokens, detail on mapping per-customer directories (for example to organizations), independent or hands-on corroboration of SCIM provisioning.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can sync users and groups from customer directories via SCIM so deprovisioning in the IdP revokes app access
